title: Duplicate-free terms under CNF dualization
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number and let $\psi$ be a CNF formula on $n$ variables. If every clause of $\psi$ contains no repeated literal, then every term of its De Morgan dual DNF contains no repeated literal.
hypotheses_covered: $\psi$ is a CNF formula on $n$ variables
replaced:
Let $\psi$ be a CNF formula whose clauses are lists of literals, and suppose that every
clause of $\psi$ contains no repeated literal. Then every term of the De Morgan dual DNF
obtained from $\psi$ — the DNF formed by negating each literal of each clause — likewise
contains no repeated literal.
